title: Pointer to the properties of scalar extension
text:
In the notation of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], the following holds.
That this construction is well defined, that it is an exact triangulated
functor, and that it is compatible with composition of finite extensions are
[lem-weil-scalar-extension-well-defined],
[lem-weil-scalar-extension-exact-triangulated], and
[lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition].
